casebody.head_matter:
Robert STRATTON, petitioner,
v.
Brian COLEMAN, Superintendent, State Correctional Institution at Fayette, et al.
No. 12-8093.
Supreme Court of the United States
June 3, 2013.
On petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit. Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis and petition for writ of certiorari granted. Judgment vacated, and case remanded to the United States Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit for further consideration in light of McQuiggin v. Perkins, 569 U.S. ----, 133 S.Ct. 1924, 185 L.Ed.2d 1019 (2013).
